info.name: ChangeCars - Multi Filter Tests
info.description: Run the collection to test single filters, AND combinations, OR choices, scoped models and counts. Results requests also call count and facets automatically to check totals. baseUrl defaults to online Railway; change to http://localhost:4000/api/v1 for local tests. New facets fields require commit 4bc24ba or later deployed. A zero result is valid, especially for fuel/transmission missing from imported source data. Facets include all supplied filters.
